verdict.rationale: Numeral's docs mention 'Validate customer VAT IDs live' as a pricing feature, but there is no evidence describing real-time validation against official EU/UK VAT registries, nor any mention of reverse-charge mechanics for B2B cross-border sales — the product's core documented flows (calculations, transactions, nexus, filings) are framed around US/global sales tax rather than EU VAT reverse-charge logic. missing for 10: documentation of registry-level VAT ID validation (e.g. VIES), explicit reverse-charge application logic, and any hands-on/independent confirmation of correct B2B cross-border handling.
